ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and follow the money to see where it leads
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. I will use data analysis and public records to follow the money and see where it leads.
